# A project's number as a SQL qualifier, as BigQuery answers: it names the project as its ID
# does, and INFORMATION_SCHEMA names the project by its ID, test. The test project's number is
# 123456789012.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/resource-hierarchy#projects

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `123456789012.scalars.t`
=> "4"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `123456789012`.scalars.t
=> "4"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `123456789012`.`region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = "scalars"
=> "1"

SELECT LOGICAL_AND(catalog_name = "test") FROM `123456789012`.`region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = "scalars"
=> "true"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `123456789012`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = "scalars"
=> "1"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `123456789012`.scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE table_name = "t"
=> "1"

SELECT LOGICAL_AND(table_catalog = "test") FROM `123456789012`.scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE table_name = "t"
=> "true"
